en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large hilltop castle complex with multiple steep-roofed buildings and a round central tower, alongside a baroque-style church with an onion-shaped spire. Below the rocky, wooded slope sit several smaller houses and a stone bridge crossing a stream in the foreground. The overall style and setting suggest a central European medieval townscape. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image.
